title: Midnight Season 2 Mythic+: The Official Dungeon Pool and Rewards
summary: Season 2's official Mythic+ pool is eight dungeons, including Altar of Fangs, with rating rewards through Keystone Myth.

title: Midnight Hotfixes Buff Several Specs and Ease the Venomous Abyss
summary: Official Oct 27 class tuning and Nov 5–6 raid hotfixes buff several Midnight specs and ease Ula'tek and the Venomous Abyss.

title: Echoes of the Worldcore Is on the PTR; Eclipse Remains Officially Announced
summary: Blizzard's next Midnight update, Echoes of the Worldcore, is on the PTR. Eclipse is announced as the final major patch, with no dates.

title: November’s Trading Post Has a Sweet Tooth Theme and a Bunmover Mount
summary: November's official Trading Post theme is Sweet Tooth. Fill the Traveler's Log to earn the Hot Motocross Bunmover 4600.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Is Now Live
summary: WoW: Forever launched worldwide on November 4, 2026, with new zones, the Skyborne, rulesets, and a first-login interface preset.

title: Midnight 12.1.5 Is Live: Kith'ix, the Labyrinth, and Season 2's Mid-Season Refresh
summary: Midnight's 12.1.5 update is live, adding the Unbinding of Kith'ix, the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, Aqir Invasions, and Season 2 catch-up.

title: WoW: Forever Hotfixes Tune Classes, Buff Dungeon XP, and Tighten PvP Balance
summary: Launch-week Forever hotfixes buff dungeon XP by 50%, retune Enhancement, Hunters, and Warlocks, and tighten PvP faction creation.

title: Discord Account Linking and Guild Chat Mirroring Come to WoW and Forever
summary: Modern WoW and WoW: Forever now support Discord account linking and two-way guild chat mirroring for players and officers.

title: Claim the Pouch of Violet Dust Before the Forever Twitch Drop Ends
summary: The Pouch of Violet Dust Twitch Drop for WoW: Forever closes November 12 at 4:30 p.m. PST. Watch four hours to claim the camp toy.
